book.name: 1 TIMOTI
book.title: Tup ŋendehei ŋaiye Pol nainge nal me Timoti

content: Wusyep hraꞌembep nal lenge sios ŋaiye ka yahraꞌe naŋ tikin Got
Ŋendeheiyeh kin pe, ŋam masande ŋaiye na ini lenge Kristen miyeꞌ tuweinge na, “Ka yininge wusyep topoꞌme Got hriphrip me kin, topoꞌe ka yisilihme kin ŋaiye ka ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme.”

Tinge yisilihme Got ŋaiye ka ungwisme lenge kiŋ, topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ embep no, poi ya murp bwore ŋumwaiye topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwarme. Topoꞌe ya murp ŋumwaiye tuwihme Got maŋaꞌe naŋ embere milme kin ilyehme, topoꞌe ya murp bwore bwarme mil ŋembep lenge mitiŋ lalme.
Wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam mana nin ŋaiye pa yende pe, ki bwore supule nal ŋembep tikin Got. Kin Miyeꞌ nungwisme poi pe, luku ka ende kin ka hriphrip.
Tehei kin taꞌe leꞌe, Got ŋasande ŋaiye lenge mitiŋ lalme ka yusyunde wusyep mise kitikin Got no, ka ambaꞌe tinge pe, ka yurp bwore hlaininge nye nyermbe.

content.text: Detale, Got esep ilyeh kin narp,
topoꞌe miyeꞌ bumbe ilyeh ŋaiye kin narp bumbe me Got
Kin naŋaꞌe kitikin nat nal ŋaiye kin nule berme pupwa
lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme no, ka yurp hlaininge.
Ŋup uku ki sasambe, ŋaiye Got kin ŋasande tikin
ŋaiye ka ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme pe,
kin nalaŋatme ŋupe ŋaiye Jisas Krais ka ole

content: Taꞌe ti, Got nalaŋatme ŋam aposel topoꞌe jetmam tititinge lenge mitiŋ supule ŋaiye ma malaŋatme wusyep mise milme tinge no, ŋoihmbwaip tinge ka teŋeime wusyep mise luku. Wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam manange, ki bwore mise supule. Ŋam yukur homboꞌe.

Ŋam masande ŋaiye nato sios lalme ka yahraꞌe naŋ Got pe, lenge miyeꞌ lalme ka yininge wusyep topoꞌme kin. Ka yahraꞌe syep tinge yunuh yaŋaꞌe tinge supule yilme kin, kut prepwan ŋaiye ka ŋoihmbwaip nihe, topoꞌe tuhwar, na pakai.

O ŋam masande lenge tuweinge lope, ka dendeꞌ hihyilih bworerme yil tutume wutuꞌ kin pe, sekei. Prepwan ŋaiye ka yendendeꞌme dohwaih tinge ka miꞌ, topoꞌe ka yendendeꞌme wahriꞌ tinge topoꞌe salpan ŋaiye tinge yenge ŋeser yende tikin miꞌ supule. Topoꞌe prepwan ŋaiye ka birme wuhyau no, ka yambaꞌe hihyilih ŋaiye tikin miꞌ supule, na pakai.
Kut lenge Kristen tuweinge ŋaiye jande wusyep tikin Got pe, ka yende wah bwore bwore tikin Got. Luku hihyilih bwore mise tinge.
Lenge tuweinge lalme ka yurp ŋumwaiye yusyunde wusyep yi yoto sios pe, ka yurp tuwihme lenge miyeꞌ embep tikin sios.
Ŋam manange pakai supule ŋaiye tuwei ende ta tuhur gwin hlaꞌ walaŋatme wusyep Got gwin woto sios, topoꞌe yukur ta wil yer taharꞌe lenge miyeꞌ, na pakai. Ta syumbe wurp ŋumwaiye wusyunde wusyep.
Detale, Got ŋende Adam yer miꞌe pe, ki ŋende Iv nate gande.
Kom Iv woworꞌe wusyep erŋeme tikin Got yer. Detale, ti wasande wusyep molohe Satan pe, ti wende hwap.

Ti wende taꞌe luku, kom Got se ka ambaꞌe lenge tuweinge ŋaiye ka yaraꞌe talah, ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge ka teŋeime Got, topoꞌe ka yende nihararme lenge mitiŋ, topoꞌe ka yurp ŋumwaiye, topoꞌe ka yahraꞌe naŋ kin.
